Class TelemetrySubscription

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.telemetry.TelemetrySubscription
public final class TelemetrySubscription extends Object
Immutable telemetry subscription contract governing what variables, spatial raster slices, and subsampling cadence are evaluated during simulation ticks or post-hoc snapshot extraction.

By default (NONE), no metrics or spatial slices are subscribed and telemetry execution incurs strictly zero CPU overhead per tick.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
